# UCSC Environmental Health & Safety

> > UCSC EH&S provides comprehensive environmental health, safety, and compliance programs to build a culture of safety across the campus community.

The Environmental Health & Safety department at UC Santa Cruz manages workplace safety, environmental compliance, fire prevention, research safety, and hazard mitigation. The site serves faculty, staff, students, and visitors with policies, procedures, and resources for maintaining a safe and compliant campus environment.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S)
- Campus Safety
- Fire Safety & Prevention
- Research Safety
- Biosafety
- Hazardous Waste Management
- Environmental Compliance
- Workplace Safety
- Incident Reporting
- Radiation Safety
- Chemical Safety
- Hazardous Materials
- Environmental Programs
- Regulatory Compliance
- UCSC

## Core Programs & Overview

- [Environmental Health & Safety – Building a culture of safety together](https://ehs.ucsc.edu): UCSC EH&S homepage covering safety programs, hazard reporting, and workplace safety.
- [About EH&S](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/about): Overview of UCSC EH&S department mission, organization, and campus compliance.
- [Research Safety](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/research-safety): UCSC research safety programs including biosafety and laser safety.
- [Fire Safety and Prevention](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/fire-safety-and-prevention): UCSC fire safety programs, code compliance, and prevention initiatives.
- [Environmental Programs](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs): UCSC environmental permits, compliance, and monitoring across campus.

## Research Safety & Radiation

- [Radiation Safety Programs](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/research-safety/radiation-safety-programs): Radiation safety, radioactive materials compliance, and ALARA standards.

## Environmental Compliance & Monitoring

- [Drinking Water](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/drinking-water): Drinking water safety, quality testing, and lead testing information.
- [Hazardous Material Storage](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/hazardous-material-storage): Hazardous material storage requirements, procedures, and spill response.
- [Air Emissions](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/air-emissions): Air emissions permits and compliance with MBUAPCD regulations.
- [Air Quality Monitoring](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/air-quality-monitoring): Air quality monitoring resources, AQI index, and wildfire smoke alerts.
- [Waste Water Discharge](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/waste-water-discharge): Wastewater discharge, sewer system, and drainage management.
- [Storm Water Discharge](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/storm-water-discharge): Storm water discharge compliance and reporting procedures.
- [Underground Storage Tanks](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/underground-storage-tanks): Underground storage tank compliance, leak detection, and regulations.
- [Integrated Pest Management](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/environmental-programs/integrated-pest-management): Campus IPM program, pest control, and alternative methods.

## Fire Safety & Inspections

- [Inspections & Permits](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/permits-inspections): Fire safety inspections, Title 19/24 permits, and special events.
- [Campus Housing Fire Log](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/fire-safety-and-prevention/campus-housing-fire-log): Annual fire log for residential colleges per Higher Education Act.
- [Community Risk Reduction & Public Education](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/fire-safety-and-prevention/community-outreach): Fire safety education, wildfire awareness, and community outreach.

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Us](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/about/contact-us): EH&S staff directory, emergency numbers, and incident reporting contacts.
- [Department Directory](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/about/department-directory): Comprehensive staff contacts for biosafety, chemical safety, and hazardous waste.
- [Directions to the EH&S Office](https://ehs.ucsc.edu/about/directions-to-the-ehs-office): EH&S office location, parking, and campus navigation information.
